newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek brokers market shares in April.
newsitem.headline: Greek brokers market shares in April.

text.p: April trading volume at the Athens stock exchange reached 592.5 billion drachmas, up from 552 billion in March, the exchange's members association (SMEHA) said.

The monthly market share rankings showed Alpha Brokerage leading the bourse's 63 brokers with 8.28 percent of the business, followed by Sigma Securities with 6.70 percent and National Securities with 5.92 percent.
Cumulative January-to-April trading volume reached 2.53 trillion drachmas compared to 3.97 trillion for the entire 1996.

For the first four months of the year Alpha Brokerage maintained the lead with 8.08 percent followed by Sigma Securities with 7.31 and National Securities with 6.16 percent. Devletoglou was fourth with 5.68.

SMEHA released the following data and market share rankings for April. The top 15 brokers shared 56 percent of the bourse's trading volume. The remainder went to the exchange's other 47 member brokers.
